OFFLINE_SINCE: The server isn't responding. Last seen online {{date}}
NEVER_ONLINE: Can't reach the server yet, the bot keeps trying
GRAPH_CAPTION: Online over the last day, peak {{peak}}

ERRORS.UNKNOWN_GAME: Unknown game, pick one from the list
ERRORS.ADDRESS: That doesn't look like a server address. Write it like play.example.com or 1.2.3.4:27015
ERRORS.PORT: This game has no default port, add it to the address after a colon
ERRORS.CHANNEL: The bot can't post in that channel
ERRORS.NOT_FOUND: Couldn't find that address, check it for typos
ERRORS.PRIVATE: That's a local or private address, the bot doesn't check those
ERRORS.NO_RESPONSE: The server didn't respond. Check the address, the port and the game, maybe it's just down right now
ERRORS.LIMIT: A server can monitor up to {{max}} game servers
ERRORS.EXISTS: This game server is already monitored here
